title: Turkish-Style Spiced Sausage Wrap
description: A flavorful wrap filled with spiced sausage, onions, and herbs, served with a side of tangy chutney. This Indian-inspired dish is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Turkish
ingredients.notes: Add a Middle Eastern twist with sumac and cumin

ingredients.name: Kooky
ingredients.notes: A pinch of cayenne pepper adds heat

ingredients.name: Yeasty
ingredients.notes: A hint of garlic powder enhances the flavor

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the sausage into thin rounds and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, toast the flatbread on the grill or in a dry pan.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the sliced onion, sumac, cumin, cayenne pepper, and garlic powder.
5. Add the cooked sausage to the bowl and toss with the onion mixture.
6. Assemble the wraps by spooning the sausage mixture onto the toasted flatbread.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
8. Serve with a side of tangy chutney for dipping.
